exact_statement: Let S,W,U,V be compatible point indicators on disjoint blocks of positive widths s,L,R,T and g an independent balanced Boolean core. For F=1+(WUV OR SU OR SV)(g-1), when R=T=1 the physical policy exposing S then WUV on failure or U OR V on success has zero strict-threshold-4 bad-node prefix charge and retains terminal entropy pi H(g). With L=2s and g=z, the actual sign family F_s has n=3s+3 and unfiltered separator face price R_all/I(F_s)>=11s/48 and R_all/(I(F_s)-I_separator)>=11s(s+1)/60 for every s>=1. Thus no fixed constant pays that explicitly defined unfiltered repeated full-price rule. The same family has complete-tree Q_bad,4=0 and H(F_s)<7 I(F_s). More generally a point-selector query switching arbitrary Boolean branches with disagreement gamma>0 satisfies B_i/Inf_i<=2+log2(e)/sqrt(e gamma), hence is strictly 4-good if gamma>=1/4. This does not refute A023 v2, a localized existential stopping theorem or FEI.

exact_statement: Let S,W,U,V be compatible point indicators on disjoint uniform blocks of positive widths s,L,R,T and g an independent balanced Boolean core. For F=1+[WUV OR S(U OR V)](g-1), query the separator S until first failure or completion, then resolve WUV or U OR V and stop at a constant or g. Put alpha=2^-s, q=2^-R,r=2^-T,eta=2^-(L+R+T),e=q+r-qr-eta,JB=(L+R+T)eta,JC=R q(1-r)+T r(1-q),JD=JB+JC,pi=eta+alpha e,m=ceil(log2(min(R,T)+2))+2 and M=min(s,m). Every live separator query with j>m remaining bits is strictly K=4-good. The nonnegative reserve at live state j is V_j=2^-j[min(j,m) JD+e min(j,m)(min(j,m)-1)/2+min(j,m)e I(g)], set zero after failure. Its exact physical drift V_j-V_(j-1)/2 equals the actual child-product face price c_j=2^-j[JD+(j-1)e+e I(g)] when j<=m and zero otherwise. Thus the actual localized separator bill is <=V_s<=M I_other+(M-1)I_sep/2+M I_terminal<=M I(F), where I_sep=s alpha e,I_other=(1-alpha)JB+alpha JC,I_terminal=pi I(g). Terminal entropy remains pi H(g), and H(F)<=(4+2/ln2)(I_sep+I_other)+V_s+pi H(g). This eliminates dependence on separator length s for fixed R,T, but is not a universal influence constant or terminal-core certificate.
